problem: A trusted Proof Broker that updates request/status labels on pull requests cannot reliably perform those writes with pull-requests: read.
invariant: A broker workflow that owns pull-request proof labels must receive the minimum pull-requests: write permission in the trusted default-branch orchestration jobs, while keeping all unrelated scopes read-only or absent.
evidence: YACS PR #256 currently carries broker-managed proof request/status labels after the permission correction
do_not_copy: YACS proof ids and Passo Giau workflow names
failure_behavior: If the broker cannot update its owned PR labels, report BLOCKED/FAIL with the API result; never broaden to write-all or silently claim status reconciliation succeeded.
